notes: Copy to clipboard now means it. Plus a What's new list, a box for ideas, and a new look.

whatsNew.title: Copy to clipboard now means it
whatsNew.body: With the switch off, what you dictated was still being left on the clipboard. It is taken back after the paste, and marked so it stays out of clipboard history.

whatsNew.title: What's new, and a way to reach me
whatsNew.body: This list, under Updates. At the bottom there is a box for ideas that opens an email to me, and a way to chip in if you want to.

whatsNew.title: No Essential Key? Use the power button
whatsNew.body: The assistant-gesture setup moved under The key, folded away until you need it.

whatsNew.title: New icon, and a flatter look
whatsNew.body: Grey page, near-white cards, no outlines anywhere, and buttons that are black instead of yellow.
